chapter.v:
Early the
following morning Joshua and the Israelites set out from Shittim and arrived at the banks of the Jordan. There they all spent the night before crossing over.

Three days
later those in charge of the people went through the camp

telling the
people, “When you see the Ark of the Agreement of the Lord your God carried by the priests, the Levites, you must leave the place where you are and follow it.

That way
you'll know which way to go, since you haven't been here before. Leave about 3,000 feet between you and the Ark. Don't go near it!”

Then Joshua
said to the people, “Make sure you are pure, because tomorrow the Lord is going to do amazing things among you.”

Joshua spoke
to the priests, “Pick up the Ark of the Agreement and go before the people.” So they picked up the Ark of the Agreement and went ahead of the people.

The Lord
said to Joshua, “What I do today will confirm you as a great leader in the sight of all the Israelites, so that they'll realize that just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

Tell the
priests carrying the Ark of the Agreement, ‘When you get to the edge of the Jordan, take a few steps into the water and then stop.’”

So Joshua
said to the Israelites, “Come here and listen to what the Lord your God has to say to you.

This is
how you will know that the living God is right here with you,” he told them. “You can be sure that he will drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.

Just watch—the
Ark of the Agreement of the Lord of all the earth will cross in front of you through the Jordan.

Choose twelve
men from the tribes of Israel, one per tribe.

The moment
the priests carrying the Ark step into the water the river will stop flowing and the water will pile up.”

So the
people broke camp and set out to cross the Jordan, with the priests carrying the Ark ahead of them.

As it
was harvest season, the Jordan was full of water, overflowing its banks. But at the very moment the priests carrying the Ark stepped into the water, the river stopped flowing.

The water
piled up a long way upstream, at the town of Adam, near Zarethan, while downstream no more water flowed into the Dead Sea. So the people crossed over, opposite Jericho.

The priests
carrying the Ark stood on the dried-up riverbed of the Jordan as all the people went by, staying there until everyone had crossed over on dry ground.
